items.title: Jimmie "Kid" Clayton Interview
items.q: And we used to play all over Mississippi. One night we was in Columbia, Mississippi, and I was playing with Abby, two that night

ctx.x: It was great. Yeah, lucky they got prepared that.

It must have been about a ten or fifteen foot jump. It was dark, you see. It looked like I was stunning myself, you know, coming right down on my feet, all of us, the whole bunch of, while we had been drinking, you know, too, you see. And we used to play all over Mississippi. One night we was in Columbia, Mississippi, and I was playing with Abby, two that night, one Christian's night. And he gives the man my ticket, and I goes on off, you know, with a girl, and they all left me. So when I was a freshman I went…
You were on Greyhound? Yeah, we was on Greyhound. In those days I guess they weren't so modern anyway. No they weren't so modern.
